note: Committed in-game census for the vehicle mass model. Every row pairs the in-engine default bounding box (the two-argument boundingBoxReal result the runtime reads) with a sourced real-world mass from a held catalogue analogue. The geometry is in-engine, measured on a dedicated server. The masses are catalogue analogues, not measured on the in-game vehicle. Every pairing is class_only: the in-game class token binds the catalogue vehicle through data/vehicle/class_map.json, and no in-game class name names a catalogue vehicle. This is a census of the spawnable ground vehicle population, not a probability sample.

fit.convention: fill_low = min(ratio)/7850*(1-m); fill_high = max(ratio)/7100*(1+m); ratio = real_mass_kg / in_game_box_volume_m3
fit.margin_justification: Flat small-sample margin. Each token holds only two to four rows, so the min-max range understates the true spread. The margin is not tuned to a target.

leave_one_out.convention: each row is scored with its class-token fill refit from the other rows of the same token
